description.narrative: The program is organized under two Subprograms: Sustainable Tourism Regulation Marketing (Subp.1) and Investment in Demonstrative and Small Projects. The first comprises three components : (i) a system for accreditation and certification (SAC) of local companies and personnel; (ii) regulation for sustainable tourism; and (iii) marketing. The second has two: (i) demostrative projects --US$100 thou to US$1m; and (ii) small projects --US$25 to 100 thou.
